$schema.description: Path or URL to this schema.

url.description: SQLAlchemy URL for the RAG database (psycopg3 driver).

hnsw_ef_search.description: HNSW probe width at query time. Higher is better recall, slower.

name.description: Display name of the corpus owner.

identities.description: Identities belonging to the owner as 'kind:value' strings, e.g. 'git_email:me@example.com'. Anything authored by an identity NOT listed here is treated as reference rather than authored.

ollama_host.description: Base URL of the Ollama server that produces embeddings.

default_model.description: Slug of the model used when a command does not name one. Must be registered with 'garage register-model' first.

max_inflight.description: Concurrent embedding requests. Ollama serializes model execution, so more than one adds contention rather than throughput.

overlap.description: Characters repeated between adjacent prose chunks, so a sentence spanning a boundary is still retrievable.

code_size.description: Target characters per code chunk. Larger, to keep functions intact.

code_overlap.description: Characters repeated between adjacent code chunks.

comms_window_minutes.description: Group consecutive messages within this many minutes into one chunk. Individual messages are too short to embed usefully.

comms_window_messages.description: Also close a conversation window after this many messages.

materialize.description: Download cloud placeholder files when encountered. Reading a stub asks the provider to fetch it, so a large online-only folder can mean hundreds of gigabytes. Bounded by the limits below.

limit.description: Files materialized per run; 0 means unlimited.

max_bytes.description: Byte budget per run; 0 means unlimited.

timeout_seconds.description: Give up on a single download that never arrives. A stalled provider cannot be cancelled, so this stops it blocking the run.

max_chunks_per_document.description: Backstop so no single document can dominate the index.

reject_machine_generated.description: Reject logs, dumps, and checksum manifests by content shape.

max_file_bytes.description: Skip files larger than this; usually archives or disk images.

pdf_min_chars_per_page.description: Below this, escalate a PDF page from pypdf to pdfplumber.

ocr_min_confidence.description: Mean Tesseract word confidence below which cloud OCR is considered.

ocr_min_chars.description: Below this many characters an image is treated as having no text. Most images in a source tree are icons.

workers.description: Extraction worker processes. Leave headroom for Postgres and Ollama.

host.description: Bind address. This server has no authentication and exposes the whole corpus, so a non-loopback address needs --allow-remote.

path.description: HTTP route the MCP endpoint is served on.

enable_ocr.description: Allow the Claude vision fallback for unreadable images.

model.description: Model used for the vision OCR fallback.

max_images.description: Cap on images escalated to the cloud per run.

api_key_file.description: Path to a file containing the Anthropic API key. Kept out of this file so the config itself holds no secrets.

sources.description: Sources to index. Declared sources are re-applied on every run; sources present only in the database are left untouched.

root.description: Directory or file to index. '~' is expanded.

include_code.description: Index source files as well as documents.

allow_cloud_enrichment.description: Permit the cloud OCR fallback for this source. Never honoured for communication sources.

enabled.description: Set false to skip this source.
